content.value_statement: Authentication and payment work is high risk and often spans SDK setup, routes, webhooks, and environment variables. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Clerk, Supabase Auth, and Stripe implementation steps.
actual_capabilities: Routes requests to authentication or payment documentation based on user intent.
Guides Clerk or Supabase Auth setup for sign-up, login, social login, email verification, password reset, and profiles.
Guides Stripe subscriptions, one-time payments, webhooks, and customer portal setup.
Displays security checklists before authentication or payment work begins.
Highlights safer handling for passwords, card data, webhook signatures, amounts, errors, and logs.
limitations: Does not provide provider credentials, dashboard settings, or live API keys.
Does not replace provider documentation or production security review.
Does not automatically verify runtime behavior or deployed webhook delivery.
Concise documentation may need project-specific adaptation.

use_cases.title: Add Login to an App
use_cases.description: Guide a developer through Clerk or Supabase Auth setup, login UI, and protected route configuration.

use_cases.title: Launch Paid Plans
use_cases.description: Guide a founder through Stripe checkout, subscription flow, webhook handling, and customer portal setup.

use_cases.title: Review Security Steps
use_cases.description: Show an implementation checklist for passwords, sessions, card data, webhook signatures, and sensitive logs.

prompt_templates.title: Add Basic Login
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a standard authentication flow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Add login and sign-up to this app with Clerk or Supabase Auth. Explain which provider fits this project before editing files.

prompt_templates.title: Protect User Routes
prompt_templates.prompt: Set up protected routes for signed-in users. Include middleware, redirect behavior, and a short security checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Implement Stripe Billing
prompt_templates.prompt: Add Stripe subscription billing with checkout, webhook handling, and a customer portal. Keep product prices controlled on the server.

prompt_templates.title: Integrate Auth and Payments
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a complete SaaS flow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Connect authentication and Stripe billing for this SaaS app. Map user identity, subscription status, protected routes, and failure states.

output_examples.input: Add Google login to my app.
output_examples.output: The skill would identify the project structure, choose Clerk or Supabase Auth, add login UI, protect routes, and list required environment variables.

output_examples.input: Add monthly and yearly paid plans.
output_examples.output: The skill would outline Stripe checkout, server-side price selection, webhook verification, subscription status storage, and customer portal access.

output_examples.input: Check whether my auth flow is safe enough.
output_examples.output: The skill would return a checklist covering password storage, session cookies, CSRF, rate limits, error messages, and sensitive logging.

best_practices: Confirm the provider choice before changing authentication or billing files.
Keep secrets in environment variables and never expose them in client code.
Verify webhooks and confirm prices on the server before granting access.
anti_patterns: Do not store raw passwords, card numbers, or private API keys in application data.
Do not trust client-provided prices, plan names, or subscription status.
Do not skip security review for authentication, sessions, webhooks, or billing access.

faq.question: Which providers does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers Clerk, Supabase Auth, and Stripe based on the included documentation.

faq.question: Can it choose between Clerk and Supabase Auth?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide provider selection after checking the project structure and user needs.

faq.question: Does it create production-ready payment flows?
faq.answer: It guides Stripe checkout, subscriptions, webhooks, and customer portal setup. Production review is still required.

faq.question: Does it handle sensitive payment card data?
faq.answer: No. It directs card handling to Stripe and warns against storing card data on the application server.

faq.question: Can it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should users check before release?
faq.answer: Users should verify sessions, rate limits, CSRF protection, webhook signatures, server-side pricing, and sensitive logging.
